Unlike [Voxel File I/O (binvox/rawvox)](1698-voxel-file-i-o-binvox-rawvox.md) which uses dense or simple sparse grids, this method handles the hierarchical scene graph and chunk-based binary format specific to Magica Voxel [S2, unofficial].

The evidence in Source [S2] explicitly states that the .vox format is developed for Magica Voxel, structures data into chunks (MAIN, PACK, SIZE, XYZI, RGBA), limits coordinates to 0-255 per axis, and represents scenes as a tree of nodes (chunks) with specific types (nTRN, nGRP, nSHP). This aligns perfectly with the claim's description of the method handling a hierarchical scene graph and chunk-based binary format specific to Magica Voxel.
